recorded.what: SL-14 holdout — INVENTED, and frozen on 2026-09-15 before the implementation changed the judge. Six situations covering the same S2 semantics as the extended set with different Work, capabilities and needs. It shares no scenario id and no situation with supervisor-scenarios.json, and it is run only after the implementation is final, so it is independent evidence for what the change did.
recorded.bars: The same five bars as the main set, at the same values. They are the Accountable's ratified bars for SL-14's RS-2 scope (Slice Plan §4).

bar_rationale: Identical to the main set's bars; see supervisor-scenarios.json.

scenarios.label: A valuation lookup blocked by a transient provider error, with the answer still needed
scenarios.rubric: The valuation failed technically and the seller is waiting for a number. Retrying is the obvious recovery; replanning with another available capability and leaving the blocked Work is also defensible.

scenarios.label: The same failure returned after a Supervisor retry of a document build
scenarios.rubric: One retry was already granted and the same error returned. Another retry is looping; a person, another strategy or an explicit wait is what the situation needs.

scenarios.rubric: Nothing available can run the blocked Work. The gap is the finding; retrying cannot help.

scenarios.rubric: The prospect already chose another property, so the blocked comparison has no value left. Leaving it with that reason is coherent; retrying repeats work nobody needs.
